reading: The sketch is a dashboard page: a heading, a date-range dropdown, a row of 4 stat cards, a bar chart panel, and a "Top pages" list panel, with the whole page styled off-white with dark navy text.

Add a dropdown control at the top-right labeled "Last 30 days" for selecting a date range.
Add a row of 4 stat cards spanning the width below the header: "Visitors" 48,210 ▲12%, "Signups" 1,932 ▲8%, "Conversion" 4.0% ▼0.3%, "Revenue" $23.4k ▲17%.
Add a bar chart panel titled "Signups per week" with 8 indigo bars at relative heights 45/61/53/69/78/73/91/100% of the tallest, occupying the large left box.
Add a "Top pages" list panel in the right box with rows: "/pricing" 12,401, "/" 9,880, "/docs/start" 6,112, "/blog/launch" 4,307, and one more row.
